attchmntText: Vardhman Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication

attchmntText: Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Sangam India Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported record quarterly revenue of INR1,045 crores, up 33% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR127 crores and PAT at INR53 crores. For the half-year, revenue was INR1,906 crores with PAT at INR94 crores. Managing Director Anurag Soni stated the company is on track to double PAT for FY27. Capacity utilization remains high. The company is investing INR1,500 crores over two to three years to expand capacity and increase renewable power generation to 70% by Q1 next year. Debtor days increased to 77 days due to government tenders and export delays. India Ratings upgraded the long-term rating to IND A with a stable outlook.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has intimated the schedule for upcoming analyst and institutional investor meets. The company will participate in the CLSA India Forum on Monday, November 16, 2026, in Mumbai. This will be followed by the Avendus Spark INDX Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The JM Financial Annual India Conference is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Meetings will be conducted via individual or institutional one-on-one physical or group interactions. The schedule may be revised due to unforeseen circumstances. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these engagements. This information is available on the company website at www.tatapower.com.

attchmntText: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations reached Rs 863 crore in Q2 FY27, up 14.6 percent from Rs 753 crore in Q1. Profit before tax was Rs 51.2 crore, compared to Rs 44.1 crore in the previous quarter. EBITDA margin stood at 10.2 percent. The consolidated order book increased by 10.2 percent to Rs 10,940 crore as of 30th September 2026. The company secured an additional freight car order worth Rs 412 crore from Indian Railways in October 2026. New orders added between 1st October 2026 and 5th November 2026 totaled Rs 349 crore from Indian Railways. The company received an upgraded CRISIL A+/Stable rating for long-term bank facilities. ESG score improved from 51 to 59.

attchmntText: Apollo Pipes Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Apollo Pipes Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. Consolidated sales volume grew 13% year-on-year to 24,501 tons, with revenue rising 31% to INR309.6 crores. Consolidated EBITDA recovered to INR11.5 crores, representing a 3.7% margin. The company entered the ceramic tiles segment through the acquisition of Mazzini Tiles. Management targets expanding capacity to 2,88,000 tons within two years, funded by internal cash flow. Apollo Pipes standalone EBITDA margin stood at 5.7%. The company aims to reach an EBITDA per ton of INR9,000 to INR10,000 for Apollo standalone in the second half of FY27. Kisan is targeted to reach breakeven in the next six months.

attchmntText: Jyoti Structures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled ""Jyoti Structures Limited Aims for a Larger Order Book with the Availability of Bank Guarantees/Letters of Credit from Lenders."".
voiceSummary: Jyoti Structures Limited announces the progressive release of bank guarantees and letters of credit by its lenders. This action follows the NCLT approved resolution plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, and the NCLAT order dated 26 May 2026. After a five-year delay, lenders are disbursing facilities from the INR 510.59 crores envisaged in the plan. These facilities are being made available in line with current business requirements. The prior non-availability of these instruments limited the company's ability to execute its order book. Their release strengthens the operational platform and supports the execution of the growing order book. The company aims to pursue new opportunities in the power transmission and infrastructure sectors. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "JSW Steel reports Consolidated Crude Steel Production of  25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026"
voiceSummary: JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026, representing a 19% year-on-year growth. Indian operations contributed 24.86 Lakh Tonnes, while JSW Steel USA Ohio contributed 0.87 Lakh Tonnes. Capacity utilization for Indian operations was 92%. Previous year figures have been adjusted to exclude the Bhushan Power and Steel Limited steel business undertaking transferred to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026. The company is the flagship business of the JSW Group and aims to expand its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "TACC Receives Approval Letter for Rs 609.50 Crore Incentive under ECMS for its Synthetic Graphite Anode Material Project in Dewas".
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, received an approval letter for an incentive of Rs 609.50 crore under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme. The incentive supports TACC’s Synthetic Graphite Anode Material project in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The facility spans over 100 acres and targets a phase one capacity of 20,000 tonnes per annum by June 2027. The project aims for a total committed capacity beyond 30,000 metric tonnes per annum by FY2028-29. The approval is subject to scheme guidelines and prescribed conditions.

attchmntText: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
sm_name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited
voiceSummary: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR1,363 crores, an EBITDA of INR279 crores, and a PAT of INR76 crores. Operational highlights included IP volumes of 81,668 and OP volumes of 731,010. Management discussed acquisitions in Kakinada, Sangli, Secunderabad, and Guntur, along with operations management agreements in Hyderabad and Thrissur. The call addressed the impact of trade margin rationalization on anti-cancer drugs, noting final details were pending disclosure on 9th November. Management also commented on the ramp-up of the Kondapur unit, margin normalization in the Andhra Pradesh cluster due to new oncology programs, and a one-time INR8 crores provision for doubtful debts related to government business.

attchmntText: Aarti Drugs Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aarti Drugs Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE. The call, held on November 04, 2026, featured Managing Director Adhish Patil and other executives. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 reached Rs. 829 crores, up 27% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 63% to Rs. 138 crores with a margin of 16.6%. Profit after tax rose 83% to Rs. 83 crores. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue was Rs. 1,532 crores, up 23%. EBITDA stood at Rs. 235 crores, up 48%. PAT was Rs. 133 crores, up 34%. The company highlighted growth in API, specialty chemicals, and formulations segments. Management discussed capacity expansions at Tarapur, Sarigam, and Baddi facilities. An ESG rating of 61 was assigned by Crisil for FY25-26.
